description: In relay_client.rs, parse_smtp_line(&[u8]) converts the entire line to a String via String::from_utf8_lossy(..).into_owned() before extracting the 3-digit status code and continuation flag. For the hot path (SMTP response parsing in the relay loop), the String allocation is unnecessary — the status code is the first 3 bytes and can be parsed as ASCII digits directly from the byte slice. Fix: parse the status code and continuation flag from the byte slice, returning (&str, bool) borrowing from the input, or (u16, bool) with no allocation. Only convert to String if the caller needs the human-readable text portion.
title: smtp: parse_smtp_line takes &[u8] but allocates String unconditionally
